text:
Platinum Price in 2010
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2010, the LBMA platinum price rose 16.1% between 2010-01-29 ($1,512) and 2010-12-30 ($1,755). The highest sampled price was $1,755 in December and the lowest was $1,512 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,613. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
